01 / OUR SERVICES

From moving out
to moving forward.

The details that make a rental property feel ready again. Service scope is agreed for each property.

01

End-of-lease cleaning

A detailed clean for the end of a tenancy and the start of the next.

  • Kitchen, oven and rangehood
  • Bathrooms, showers and toilets
  • Floors, skirting boards and cupboards
  • Interior windows and accessible tracks
  • Carpet and additional cleaning by arrangement
02

Repairs & refreshes

Practical attention to everyday wear and tear between tenancies.

  • Wall patching and paint touch-ups
  • Doors, handles, hinges and locks
  • Cupboard fittings, blinds and flyscreens
  • Bathroom silicone and minor grout repairs
  • Garden tidying and outdoor upkeep
03

Specialist coordination

Help arranging the right specialist when a property needs more.

  • Plumbing leaks and drainage issues
  • Electrical faults and lighting
  • Air conditioning and appliance servicing
  • Pest treatment and specialist cleaning

Specialist work is subject to assessment and suitable trade availability. Licensed trades are used where required.
